digest.component_or_area: DC rich-text harness and inbound differ
propositions: Live DC harness must assert rendered HTML via ?expand=renderedFields (not just wiki source) to verify bold/heading/code-macro markup is correctly interpreted by the real Jira DC renderer
State-based echo-safety must hold end-to-end: a pushed rich body that echoes back from Jira should not trigger a re-push on the next reconcile pass (upgrade-then-converge against real renderer)

Both-sides concurrent edit must implement settled local-wins conflict: rebar-side and Jira-side simultaneous edits to description should keep rebar's body and emit a deduped outbound-field-conflict alert without silently destroying the remote value

Inbound differ must normalize Jira's echoed wiki-rendered form (the landed wire form) as equivalent to local Markdown so echo-suppression holds bidirectionally, matching outbound's _baseline_form_matches behavior
Cross-repo contract test must pin normalize_rich_text signature and behavior to prevent breaking changes to agentic-dev-platform's InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text import
